title: Yellow Citrusy Australian Shiitake Mushroom Bowl
description: A citrusy and crunchy Australian dish featuring shiitake mushrooms, perfect for a hangover cure, and is dairy-free friendly. This bowl is packed with nutritious ingredients to help you recover.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and ginger.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the mushrooms on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15 minutes.
In a pan, heat the kimchi over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add the turmeric to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and add it to the pan, stirring to combine with the kimchi and turmeric.
Season the quinoa mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble the bowls, divide the quinoa mixture among four bowls, then top with the roasted mushrooms.
